_note: Reference body for `databricks apps create`. scripts/deploy.sh builds this body itself (see
app_body()) and is the source of truth; this file is here so the shape is readable, and so the
repository URL cannot drift unnoticed. It pointed at `edgegenie` — a different repository —
until 2026-11-10, which would have created an app that built code nobody in this repository wrote.
The `git_repository` is required on a workspace that deploys apps from git only (measured on
dbc-cb61f1e1-bd8e: `apps create` refuses without it, and `apps deploy` refuses a Workspace
path). A workspace that accepts a Workspace-folder source does not need it.
